ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a JK flip-flop. On the left side there is a clock input CP, and inside the flip-flop the J and K input terminals are marked. The upper right side is the normal output Q, and the lower right side with a small circle is the complementary output Q̄. In the figure, a feedback line is drawn from the complementary output Q̄, goes around to the upper left, and connects to the J input terminal; the K input terminal is connected from the lower left to the ground symbol, so K=0. Reasoning: The characteristic equation of a JK flip-flop is Q^{n+1}=J·Q̄^n+K̄·Q^n. From the figure, J=Q̄^n and K=0, so K̄=1. Substituting gives Q^{n+1}=Q̄^n·Q̄^n+1·Q^n=Q̄^n+Q^n=1. Therefore the next state is always 1.
